::: {#thm-pooled-t-null}
#### Null distribution of the pooled t statistic

Let the observations in both groups be independent and Gaussian,
all with the same mean and the same variance $\varpar$.
Then $t_p$ (@def-pooled-t-test), computed from these random variables,
has the $t_{n_1 + n_2 - 2}$ distribution [@hoggtanis2015, Section 8.2, p. 371].
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-pooled-t-equal-variances}
#### The equal-variance assumption

@thm-pooled-t-null needs equal variances in the two groups,
and Welch's test (@def-two-sample-t-test) does not,
so these notes use Welch's test by default.
:::
